description: Li₃Na(NH₂)₄ crystallizes in the tetragonal I̅4 space group. Na is bonded in a 8-coordinate geometry to four equivalent N and four equivalent H atoms. All Na-N bond lengths are 2.53 Å. All Na-H bond lengths are 2.55 Å. There are two inequivalent Li sites. In the first Li site, Li is bonded in a tetrahedral geometry to four equivalent N atoms. All Li-N bond lengths are 2.07 Å. In the second Li site, Li is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to four equivalent N and two equivalent H atoms. There are two shorter (2.10 Å) and two longer (2.22 Å) Li-N bond lengths. Both Li-H bond lengths are 2.24 Å. N is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to one Na, three Li, and two H atoms. Both N-H bond lengths are 1.03 Å. There are two inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Li and one N atom. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one N atom.
